verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents native, same-platform MDM/UEM across Windows, Linux, macOS, iOS, iPadOS and Android (docs-8, docs-22). Device management sits in the same directory as identities (docs-26), and conditional access revokes access when a device falls out of compliance (docs-7). Community users confirm running JumpCloud MDM across Mac/Windows/Linux from one pane of glass (comm-1, comm-2). missing for 10: explicit documentation of the device enrollment flow, explicit remote lock/wipe capability, detailed policy-enforcement documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of lock/wipe tied to identity.
